versions.changelog:
- Added a README.md file to improve documentation.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of playwright-html-pdf-renderer.
- Render deterministic PDFs from HTML using local Playwright/Chromium.
- Supports both loading HTML files and setting HTML content directly.
- Waits for full page and font loading before exporting PDF.
- No API key required for local usage; API key needed for cloud browser providers.
